data.description: Monkey bars are a familiar sight on school grounds, and the Monkey Climber is our straight version. Yellow rungs run in a level line between two side ladders, set on a black frame. A child reaches up, grips a rung and moves across one bar at a time, building arm strength and grip with practice. Children tend to queue at one ladder and climb off at the other, so play flows in one direction and the line moves quickly. The footprint is 3'3" x 11'6" and the safe play area is 8'3" x 16'6". Colours are Play Yellow and New Black. Our 3-year warranty covers the galvanised pipe frame for manufacturing defects. Tell us how much open ground you have and we will check the fit.

props.pText: We fabricate the Monkey Climber from galvanised pipe at our Vasai factory and finish it in New Black with Play Yellow rungs. It can be grouted into the ground or installed self-standing. Children let go from height at both ends, so keep a soft surface under the full length of the bars and tighten any loose rung fittings during maintenance.
